A broad ribbed green dome rises above the mapped drum with small actual open lantern/cross. Corrected windows intersecting lower roofs, buried tower fields, a figure overlapping a lancet and the disconnected initial landing. District portal backing now stays behind the real recess. Fine tracery/sculptural identity and hidden/current rear detail remain approximate.
